note.fr: Pour les titulaires d'un diplôme étranger (bac marocain) : vérifiez la procédure d'admission et les conditions d'admission auprès de l'établissement.
note.en: For holders of a foreign diploma (Moroccan Bac): check the admission procedure and entry requirements with the institution.

evidence.quote: To meet the admission requirements for a September start, you must pay the full institutional tuition fee to Avans University of Applied Sciences by 15 June.

note.fr: Pour la nationalité non-EEE : candidature avant le 1er mai et paiement complet des frais de scolarité avant le début de l'année académique.
note.en: For non-EEA nationality: apply by May 1st and pay tuition fees in full prior to the start of the academic year.

evidence.quote: Students with a non-EEA nationality are required to apply by May 1st and to pay their tuition fees in full prior to the start of the academic year.
